title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
summary: Gap-free daily maximum temperature (temperature_2m_max) for any latitude/longitude globally, derived from ERA5/ERA5-Land reanalysis (1940-present) and ECMWF IFS (2017-present, 9 km resolution). The API is free, requires no authentication, and is registered with approved production use for UC2. Probes for Verona (45.44, 10.99) confirmed daily_max_temperature_2m values for both the history window (June 2023–May 2025) and the recent window (June 2025–March 2026). Latency of a few days may apply for the most recent days, typical of reanalysis data. Licence: CC BY 4.0 — commercial use allowed with attribution.

fields.name: daily.temperature_2m_max
fields.description: Daily maximum temperature at 2 m above ground

fields.name: hourly.time
fields.description: Hourly timestamps (returned by default even when only daily is requested)

fields.name: hourly.shortwave_radiation

schema.notes: The API returns JSON with daily and hourly data arrays. The 'daily' object always contains 'time' plus the requested daily variables. Hourly variables are returned even if only daily variables were requested (they come from the register's default_query). The key field for N3 is 'daily.temperature_2m_max'. Other daily variables available include precipitation_sum, wind_speed_10m_max, etc.

temporal.refresh_cadence: reanalysis updated multiple times per year; newest data typically has a few days latency

spatial.notes: Global coverage — must be queried by lat/lon. A single point was probed: Verona at 45.44°N, 10.99°E, as a plausible northern Italian city for the ice-cream shop. The grid cell is approx 0.1° (ERA5-Land) or 0.25° (ERA5). From 2017 onwards, 9 km resolution (ECMWF IFS). The exact shop location should be used for production.

Open-Meteo utilises open-data from various national weather services including: ... ItaliaMeteo-ARPAE (CC-BY Licence) ... Copernicus Climate Change Service C3S (Licence) — from https://open-meteo.com/en/licence
quality_notes: The API probe returned both hourly and daily data even when only daily variables were requested; the hourly temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation come from the register's default_query parameter, not from the intended production query — production code should request only daily variables to minimise response size.

Reanalysis data has a latency of a few days for very recent dates; the most recent few days of the 'recent' window (March 2026) may be from preliminary data or may have a small gap before final reanalysis is available. The probe of 28–31 March 2026 did return data, confirming coverage through to the end of the window.
The underlying data sources have mixed licences (various CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, and Copernicus licence terms), but the Open-Meteo API output is offered as CC BY 4.0 — mixed_sources flagged as true.
Geographic assumption of Verona (45.44, 10.99) must be validated against the actual shop location.
The API uses grid-averaged reanalysis data, not actual weather station measurements; values represent the grid cell average, which may differ from the microclimate at a specific shop address.

unknowns: Exact latency between real-time and reanalysis availability — the docs say 'from 1940 until now' but do not state the exact lag for the most recent days.
Whether the API has rate limits that could constrain querying the full 2-year history + 10-month recent window daily for a single lat/lon.
The exact elevation/coordinates of the Valdena Gelato Shop — Verona is assumed; production should use the precise shop coordinates.
Whether 'temperature_2m_max' is available consistently for every single day in the full period or if some days have null values (the probes only checked days that returned data).
sample_findings: daily.time: date values in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format

daily.temperature_2m_max: float values in °C — probe for 2023-06-01..03 gave [26.4, 25.2, 25.4]; probe for 2026-03-28..31 gave [16.2, 18.1, 16.2, ...]; no negative values, no nulls in the small sample
latitude/longitude: returned as 45.448154, 11.003136 (slightly different from the requested 45.44, 10.99 — API snaps to the nearest grid cell centre)
elevation: 69.0 m for the Verona grid cell
hourly.temperature_2m: hourly values in °C — sample ranged from 6.9°C to 17.1°C in the probed days
